subject: general
question:
The given pie-chart shows the percentage distribution of the expenditure incurred in manufacturing bicycles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cfa1f6c81a8137a820127c72559ce15b45c7dc626b23462c3f247c3a35be4c1.png] 

What is the central angle of the sector corresponding to the expenditure incurred on direct material cost?
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of expenditure on direct material cost = 22%

**Formula used:**

Central angle for a sector = (Percentage of expenditure × 360°) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

Central angle for direct material cost:

⇒ (22 × 360) ÷ 100

⇒ 7920 ÷ 100

⇒ 79.2°

**∴ The central angle corresponding to the expenditure incurred on direct material cost is 79.2°.**
